# SaySomething

![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/say-something)
![GitHub commit activity](https://img.shields.io/github/commit-activity/m/ranzeplay/saysth)
![GitHub contributors](https://img.shields.io/github/contributors/ranzeplay/saysth)

一款將村民連線至遠端 AI 模型的 Minecraft 模組。

## 我們正在尋求新功能

如果你有任何能讓我的模組更完善的點子，歡迎在 [GitHub 上開啟討論](https://github.com/Ranzeplay/saysth/discussions/new?category=ideas)！

我會考慮每個想法並給予回覆。若覺得不錯且我能實作，我一定會加入！

## 基本資訊

- [GitHub](https://github.com/Ranzeplay/saysth)

- [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/say-something/)

## 維基

請見 [這裡](https://saysth.ranzeplay.space) 的維基。

你也可以透過 DeepWiki 索引瀏覽維基 [這裡](https://deepwiki.com/Ranzeplay/saysth/)。

## 功能特色

- 支援多種 AI 平台。

- 運用村民資料，例如交易紀錄與職業。

- 自動總結對話內容，避免對話過於冗長。

## 範例設定

`config.json`：

```json
{  
  "personalities": [
    "decisive",
    "confident",
    "motivational",
    "analytical",
    "introspective",
    "creative",
    "empathetic",
    "supportive",
    "nurturing",
    "spontaneous",
    "curious",
    "energetic",
    "diplomatic",
    "harmonious",
    "patient",
    "imaginative",
    "visionary",
    "resourceful",
    "practical",
    "down-to-earth",
    "reliable",
    "charismatic",
    "expressive",
    "entertaining",
    "knowledgeable",
    "curious",
    "detail-oriented",
    "ambitious",
    "inspirational",
    "forward-thinking"
  ],  
  "nameCandidates": [
    "Steve",
    "Alex",
    "Jeb",
    "Lily",
    "Akane",
    "Kubo",
    "Joker"
  ],   
  "conclusionMessageLimit": 10,  
  "villagerChatPrefix": "$",  
  "useExistingVillagerName": true,  
  "showTimeConsumption": false,
  "timeoutSeconds": 10,
  "apiConfigPlatform": "cloudflare"  
}
```

`api-config.json`：

```json
{
    "modelName": "@cf/qwen/qwen1.5-14b-chat-awq",
    "accountId": "<Your Cloudflare account ID>",
    "apiKey": "<Your API key with proper permissions>"
}
```

## 注意事項

若你在搭配 OpenAI 平台使用 v1.0 時遇到問題，請先參考 [此頁面](https://github.com/Ranzeplay/saysth/issues/19)。
